module: Handles occupant faces (character heads). Loads, once, the parts of the 'skin_character_face' slot of the /vehicles/unicycle/ vehicle to build the list of available faces and the material associated with each (base 'character_display'). Provides utilities for the UI and random picking, and a process step that registers all the face materials on each 'character_head' prop of a vehicle whose occupant system is enabled.
notes: A face's material is 'character_display.skin_character_face.<skinName>' if the part has skinName, otherwise 'character_display'.
getFaceOptions returns a shared table (sorted by label): do not modify it.
getRandomFacePart crashes if no face is available (random index on an empty list).
process does nothing if vehicle.occupantSystem does not exist or is not enabled (see jbeam/sections/occupantSlots); it sets prop.faceMaterialSwitch on each head.
Material instances only exist for materials known at the end of vehicle loading, hence all faces are registered on each head.

isFacePart.desc: Tells whether the part name is a known face.

returns.desc: true if it is a face.

getFaceOptions.desc: List of faces {value = part name, label = display name}, sorted by label. Shared table, do not modify.

getRandomFacePart.desc: Name of a randomly picked face part.

getFaceMaterial.desc: Material to use for a face (base material if the part is unknown).

process.desc: Registers all face materials on the vehicle's occupant heads.
